en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ubeyd Bin Hafs Bin Qurat, from Ismail Bin Jabir, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! The bird falls upon the house, so it is seized. Is it Permissible or Prohibited, for the one who seizes it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Ismail! Is it complete or not complete (its wings)?’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! And what is complete?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who wings are level, in control of its wings going with them wherever it so desires to’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is for the one who seizes it’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ibn Faddal from ‘Ubayd ibn Fiafs ibn al-Qurt from ’Isma‘il ibn Jabir who has said the following:

“I once said to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, if a bird is trapped in the house and it is taken, is taking it lawful or unlawful. He (the Imam) asked, ‘O ’Isma‘il is it healthy or it is not healthy and free ? 5 I then asked, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause, what is healthy ? 5 He (the Imam) said, ‘It is one with complete wings with full control on them and is able to fly wherever it wants . 5 He (the Imam) said, ‘Such ones belong to whoever catches them . 555
